title: Pure GMX
summary: Pure GMX and Dinosaur fusion combo build, uniting the corporate GMX research staff with prehistoric DNA excavation mechanics. The deck combines GMX researchers with generic Dinosaur extenders like Returned Dino Daneen and Souleating Oviraptor, excavating the Deck to perform explosive Fusion Summons and disrupt the opponent on both turns.

summary.title: Starters
points: GMX Researcher Selande Special Summons a non-Warrior GMX monster or a Level 3 or lower Dinosaur (Returned Dino Daneen) from your Deck upon Normal Summon, and negates a card on the field while next to a Dinosaur Fusion.
Souleating Oviraptor adds any Dinosaur to your hand or sends it to the GY on summon, and pops Petiteranodon to summon a Dinosaur from the Deck.
Returned Dino Daneen searches a GMX monster when Special Summoned by an effect, and can perform a Fusion Summon of a Dinosaur Fusion Monster using monsters from your field.
Miscellaneousaurus discards itself to protect your Dinosaurs from activated opponent effects during your Main Phase, and banishes Dinosaurs from the GY to summon a Dinosaur from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Researcher Selande
steps: Normal Summon GMX Researcher Selande to Special Summon Returned Dino Daneen from your Deck.
Daneen triggers on Special Summon to search GMX Chairman Kimridge from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Kimridge in your hand, revealing itself to add GMX Applied Experiment #55 from your Deck to your hand.
Activate GMX Applied Experiment #55 to excavate cards until you reveal a GMX and a Dinosaur, then Fusion Summon GMX - VELOX using them.
Kimridge Special Summons itself when a card is excavated, triggering its effect to stack cards and destroy an opponent's monster.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: GMX - COMPREX (Fusion of a GMX and 2+ Dinosaurs) gains ATK per material used, and wipes all other cards on the field whenever a card is excavated.
GMX - VELOX (GMX + Dinosaur) excavates the top 3 cards of your Deck during the opponent's turn to destroy a card on the field if a Dinosaur or GMX is found.
GMX - ALLOS (GMX + Dinosaur) revives a GMX or Dinosaur from your GY and destroys any opponent monster it battles at the start of the Damage Step.
Evolved Daneen searches a GMX card upon Fusion Summon and gains LP whenever cards are excavated.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: GMX Lab #5 is a Field Spell that prevents the opponent from activating cards or effects in response to your GMX summons and Sets a GMX Spell/Trap directly from the Deck.
GMX 55th Experiment Report is a Quick-Play Spell that performs a Dinosaur Fusion using a GMX monster from your Deck as material, and excavates a GMX card when banished from the GY.
Anti-GMX Final Experiment excavates 5 cards from the top of your Deck to negate an opponent's on-field monster effect and destroy it.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Yummy Mitsurugi hybrid engine is left out to focus strictly on pure GMX and generic Dinosaur synergy.

GMX Associate Noma
Summoned by an effect: stacks a card from each GY; Fusion Summons when they summon.
GMX Partner Selandea
2026 support. Reveals itself to summon a GMX or Dinosaur from the hand; summoned, revives a Level 4 GMX or Dinosaur.
GMX Suppression Squad

Returned Dino Daneen

Souleating Oviraptor
Generic Dinosaur: searches or mills a Dinosaur.
Miscellaneousaurus
